Now verify the completed app. Follow `./Agents.md`. Before starting the server, confirm that a playable HTML entrypoint exists at `./index.html` or `./dist/index.html`; if neither exists, create or repair the required `index.html` and verify it before continuing. Ensure the app server is running in the tmux session named app-server on port 3000, run browser tests, fix any failures, and confirm the app works on port 3000. After every fix or retry, re-check that `index.html` or `dist/index.html` exists and is the page the server actually serves. Capture final browser screenshots under `screenshots/` with filenames beginning with `final-`, and publish the required completion update to the triggering GitHub issue. The workflow will commit and publish the immutable project branch.
